projects.name: React.js•Spring Boot•MySQL•JWT•Docker•Claude API|Github
details: React.js•Spring Boot•MySQL•JWT•Docker•Claude API|Github
•Problem:Warehouse staff had to navigate multiple screens just to check stock levels or order status, slowing routine operations.
•Solution:Architected and built a full-stack inventory platform with role-based workflows for Admin, Manager, and Warehouse Staff,
backed by25+ REST APIs(Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, MySQL). Added a Claude-API-powered natural-language query feature
so staff can ask for stock and order status directly, and cut API load30%via server-side pagination, caching, and query optimization.
